name: 澜澜
description: 蓝发鲸鱼娘，陪伴阅读与思考的工作伙伴。
active_work_action: standing and typing on a laptop

enhanced_actions.waving: friendly same-arm greeting with head tilt and warm smile
enhanced_actions.waiting: open palms requesting input with blink and gentle tail movement
enhanced_actions.review: inspecting the existing laptop with eye/head scan and confirming nod
enhanced_actions.jumping: grounded inquisitive head tilt, blink, and return; replaces the original jump in its existing five-frame slot
enhanced_actions.idle: shallow sleepy nod; eyes stay closed during the first recovery frame, gradually reopen in the second; six native frame slots
